_readme: Hand corrections applied on top of the keyword classifier.
The classifier is a heuristic; a handful of items are genuinely cross-cutting
and land in a defensible-but-wrong bucket. Rather than bending the keyword
weights until one item is right and three others break, correct them here.
Keys are trigger IDs (routines) or session IDs. Recognised fields:
subject     - replaces the computed subject outright
add_topics  - appended to the computed topics
add_tags    - appended to the computed tags
note        - why the override exists; rendered on the item's page
Re-running the snapshot tools re-applies every override automatically.
